stories.headline: AI-first law firm bids for a Wall Street name
site: Crosby, a law firm built around AI that is two years old, wants to take over the brand and assets of Weil Gotshal.
Weil Gotshal is a famed Wall Street firm and is preparing to dissolve.
Crosby is hiring some of the 1,200 lawyers of Weil.
Crosby says partners sign every document that its AI helped to draft.
telegram: Crosby, a two-year-old law firm built around AI, bid for the brand and assets of Weil Gotshal and is hiring some of its 1,200 lawyers.

stories.headline: Open model clones a voice from one clip
site: Edge0 published an open model that copies a voice after hearing a single audio clip.
The model works in 23 languages and runs on a laptop GPU.
According to Edge0, the cloned voice keeps the accent of the speaker.
The weights can be downloaded for free.
telegram: Edge0 released an open model that copies a voice from one clip, in 23 languages.

stories.headline: Fujifilm plans five times more magnetic tape
site: Fujifilm will spend about $63 million to produce five times more magnetic tape.
The company names the data growth of generative AI as the reason.
It says that archives of training data drive the demand.
telegram: Fujifilm will put about $63 million into five times more magnetic tape, with the data growth of generative AI as the stated reason.

stories.headline: An open model learned to break Firefox on its own
site: Epoch AI researchers gave the Chinese open-weight model GLM 5.3 a Firefox version and basic tools, and let it work alone.
Mozilla hides security fixes among routine changes, and the model saw through this and chained the bugs into a working attack.
The quickest attack needed 12 hours and about $1,000 in API fees.
Mozilla fixed the hole on October 27, in Firefox 159.0.
telegram: Given basic tools, the open model GLM 5.3 found Firefox security fixes and built working attacks on its own; the fastest took 12 hours.
Mozilla closed the hole on October 27.

stories.headline: OpenAI rewrites its Model Spec
site: OpenAI has rewritten its Model Spec, the rulebook for its models.
Under the new text the models must not block oversight, correction or shutdown.
The changes took effect on October 29, and the company says the rules will be reviewed.
